name: syntaxlab
description: SyntaxLab: multilingual syntax analysis and interactive linguistics learning

scripts.dev:api: cd services/parser-api && uv run uvicorn syntaxlab_api.main:create_app --factory --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8710
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && cd services/parser-api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && cd services/parser-api && uv run mypy
scripts.test: pnpm --filter web test && cd services/parser-api && uv run pytest
scripts.api:types: cd services/parser-api && uv run syntaxlab-api openapi ../../apps/web/lib/api/openapi.json && cd ../.. && pnpm --filter web api:types
